svg.title: Black to move after 1. e4 e5 2. Qh5 Nc6 3. Bc4, with Maia-3's likeliest replies at 1100 and 1900
svg.desc: Two copies of the same board, letters for pieces. White's queen on h5 and bishop on c4 both aim at f7. Arrows show Maia-3's three likeliest moves for Black, thicker for more likely, with their probabilities: for players rated 1100 on the left and 1900 on the right.
